question.text: The Audit Trail requirement in PMS dealings primarily ensures:

answer.text: Documentation of every investment decision: who, when, why

explanation.text: The Logic: Audit trail = record of decision rationale, approvals, execution — vital for SEBI inspection and client disputes. The Trap: Not a cosmetic requirement; regulators enforce. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B depth. Manager's Pro-Tip: Use timestamped OMS workflow instead of email chains — tampering is prevented systemically.
